summary.value: Reaction to an incoming melee attack: roll an Accuracy Check as if attacking unarmed.

system.description: Reaction to an incoming melee attack: roll an Accuracy Check as if attacking unarmed. If your result is higher than the attacker's, halve the damage. If lower, take double damage. If equal, execute a Perfect Parry — the attack is negated and you perform a free unarmed attack against the attacker.
